<<<FILE tests/reference.c>>>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#define MAX_ITEMS 1024
#define MAX_LINE 4096

typedef struct {
    char category[64];
    long long quantity;
    long long price_cents;
    long long ext_cents;
    long long qty_disc_cents;
} Item;

static long long rhaz(long long a, long long b, long long d) {
    if (d == 0) return 0;
    long long prod = a * b;
    long long q = prod / d;
    long long r = prod % d;
    if (prod >= 0) {
        if (2 * r >= d) q++;
    } else {
        if (2 * r <= -d) q--;
    }
    return q;
}

static long long parse_price(const char *s) {
    int neg = 0;
    const char *p = s;
    while (*p == ' ' || *p == '\t') p++;
    if (*p == '-') { neg = 1; p++; }
    long long whole = 0;
    while (*p >= '0' && *p <= '9') {
        whole = whole * 10 + (*p - '0');
        p++;
    }
    long long frac = 0;
    int fd = 0;
    if (*p == '.') {
        p++;
        while (*p >= '0' && *p <= '9' && fd < 2) {
            frac = frac * 10 + (*p - '0');
            fd++;
            p++;
        }
    }
    long long cents = whole * 100 + (fd == 1 ? frac * 10 : frac);
    if (neg) cents = -cents;
    return cents;
}

static int tax_rate_bp(const char *s) {
    if (strcmp(s, "CA") == 0) return 725;
    if (strcmp(s, "TX") == 0) return 625;
    if (strcmp(s, "NY") == 0) return 800;
    if (strcmp(s, "FL") == 0) return 600;
    if (strcmp(s, "WA") == 0) return 650;
    if (strcmp(s, "OR") == 0) return 0;
    if (strcmp(s, "MA") == 0) return 625;
    if (strcmp(s, "IL") == 0) return 625;
    if (strcmp(s, "PA") == 0) return 600;
    if (strcmp(s, "OH") == 0) return 575;
    return -1;
}

static int ship_idx(const char *s) {
    if (strcmp(s, "standard") == 0) return 0;
    if (strcmp(s, "express") == 0) return 1;
    if (strcmp(s, "overnight") == 0) return 2;
    return -1;
}

static const long long ship_tbl[3][5] = {
    {500, 850, 1200, 1550, 2000},
    {1000, 1500, 2000, 2500, 3200},
    {2000, 2800, 3800, 4800, 6000}
};

static int pay_bp(const char *s) {
    if (strcmp(s, "credit_card") == 0) return 250;
    if (strcmp(s, "debit") == 0) return 0;
    if (strcmp(s, "ach") == 0) return -50;
    if (strcmp(s, "cash") == 0) return 0;
    if (strcmp(s, "gift_card") == 0) return 100;
    return -1;
}

static int food_ex(const char *s) {
    return strcmp(s, "CA") == 0 || strcmp(s, "NY") == 0 ||
           strcmp(s, "MA") == 0 || strcmp(s, "PA") == 0;
}

static int cloth_ex(const char *s) {
    return strcmp(s, "PA") == 0;
}

static int med_ex(const char *s) {
    return strcmp(s, "WA") != 0;
}

static int ship_taxed(const char *s) {
    return strcmp(s, "TX") == 0 || strcmp(s, "FL") == 0 || strcmp(s, "OH") == 0;
}

static void fmt(long long c, char *buf) {
    int neg = c < 0;
    if (neg) c = -c;
    if (neg)
        sprintf(buf, "-%lld.%02lld", c / 100, c % 100);
    else
        sprintf(buf, "%lld.%02lld", c / 100, c % 100);
}

int main(void) {
    char state[64] = ""; int state_set = 0;
    char type[64] = ""; int type_set = 0;
    int texempt = 0, texempt_set = 0;
    char pay[64] = ""; int pay_set = 0;
    char smeth[64] = ""; int smeth_set = 0;
    int zone = 0, zone_set = 0;
    char coup[64] = ""; int coup_set = 0;
    Item items[MAX_ITEMS];
    int ni = 0;
    char line[MAX_LINE];

    while (fgets(line, sizeof(line), stdin)) {
        int len = strlen(line);
        while (len > 0 && (line[len-1] == '\n' || line[len-1] == '\r'))
            line[--len] = '\0';
        if (len == 0) continue;

        if (strncmp(line, "STATE=", 6) == 0) {
            state_set = 1;
            strncpy(state, line + 6, 63); state[63] = '\0';
        } else if (strncmp(line, "TYPE=", 5) == 0) {
            type_set = 1;
            strncpy(type, line + 5, 63); type[63] = '\0';
        } else if (strncmp(line, "TAX_EXEMPT=", 11) == 0) {
            texempt_set = 1;
            texempt = (strcmp(line + 11, "true") == 0);
        } else if (strncmp(line, "PAYMENT=", 8) == 0) {
            pay_set = 1;
            strncpy(pay, line + 8, 63); pay[63] = '\0';
        } else if (strncmp(line, "SHIP_METHOD=", 12) == 0) {
            smeth_set = 1;
            strncpy(smeth, line + 12, 63); smeth[63] = '\0';
        } else if (strncmp(line, "SHIP_ZONE=", 10) == 0) {
            zone_set = 1;
            zone = atoi(line + 10);
        } else if (strncmp(line, "COUPON=", 7) == 0) {
            coup_set = 1;
            strncpy(coup, line + 7, 63); coup[63] = '\0';
        } else if (strncmp(line, "ITEM ", 5) == 0) {
            if (ni < MAX_ITEMS) {
                char cat[64], ps[64];
                long long q;
                if (sscanf(line + 5, "%63s %lld %63s", cat, &q, ps) == 3) {
                    strncpy(items[ni].category, cat, 63);
                    items[ni].category[63] = '\0';
                    items[ni].quantity = q;
                    items[ni].price_cents = parse_price(ps);
                    items[ni].ext_cents = items[ni].quantity * items[ni].price_cents;
                    items[ni].qty_disc_cents = 0;
                    ni++;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (!state_set) { fprintf(stderr, "ERROR: missing STATE\n"); return 1; }
    if (!type_set) { fprintf(stderr, "ERROR: missing TYPE\n"); return 1; }
    if (!pay_set) { fprintf(stderr, "ERROR: missing PAYMENT\n"); return 1; }
    if (!smeth_set) { fprintf(stderr, "ERROR: missing SHIP_METHOD\n"); return 1; }
    if (!zone_set) { fprintf(stderr, "ERROR: missing SHIP_ZONE\n"); return 1; }
    if (ni == 0) { fprintf(stderr, "ERROR: no items\n"); return 1; }
    if (tax_rate_bp(state) < 0) { fprintf(stderr, "ERROR: unknown state\n"); return 1; }
    if (strcmp(type, "retail") != 0 && strcmp(type, "wholesale") != 0 &&
        strcmp(type, "government") != 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "ERROR: unknown type\n"); return 1;
    }
    if (pay_bp(pay) < 0) { fprintf(stderr, "ERROR: unknown payment method\n"); return 1; }
    if (ship_idx(smeth) < 0) { fprintf(stderr, "ERROR: unknown shipping method\n"); return 1; }
    if (zone < 1 || zone > 5) { fprintf(stderr, "ERROR: invalid zone\n"); return 1; }
    for (int i = 0; i < ni; i++)
        if (items[i].quantity < 0) { fprintf(stderr, "ERROR: negative quantity\n"); return 1; }
    for (int i = 0; i < ni; i++)
        if (items[i].price_cents < 0) { fprintf(stderr, "ERROR: negative price\n"); return 1; }

    long long tqd = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < ni; i++) {
        int p = 0;
        if (items[i].quantity >= 50) p = 10;
        else if (items[i].quantity >= 10) p = 5;
        items[i].qty_disc_cents = rhaz(items[i].ext_cents, p, 100);
        tqd += items[i].qty_disc_cents;
    }

    long long sub = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < ni; i++) sub += items[i].ext_cents;

    long long pq = sub - tqd;

    int bp = 0;
    int ws = (strcmp(type, "wholesale") == 0);
    if (ws) {
        if (pq >= 50000) bp = 5;
        else if (pq >= 25000) bp = 3;
    } else {
        if (pq >= 100000) bp = 5;
        else if (pq >= 50000) bp = 3;
    }
    long long bd = rhaz(pq, bp, 100);

    long long pb = pq - bd;

    long long cd = 0;
    int fs = 0;
    if (coup_set && coup[0] != '\0') {
        if (strcmp(coup, "SAVE10") == 0) {
            cd = rhaz(pb, 10, 100);
        } else if (strcmp(coup, "SAVE20") == 0) {
            if (pb >= 10000) cd = rhaz(pb, 20, 100);
        } else if (strcmp(coup, "DOLLAR5") == 0) {
            if (pb >= 5000) cd = 500;
        } else if (strcmp(coup, "DOLLAR25") == 0) {
            if (pb >= 20000) cd = 2500;
        } else if (strcmp(coup, "FREESHIP") == 0) {
            fs = 1;
        }
    }

    long long ds = pb - cd;

    int si = ship_idx(smeth);
    long long shp = ship_tbl[si][zone - 1];
    if (fs) shp = 0;

    long long fuel = rhaz(shp, 10, 100);
    if (fuel > 500) fuel = 500;

    long long tq = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < ni; i++) tq += items[i].quantity;
    long long hdl = 200 + 50 * tq;
    if (hdl > 1000) hdl = 1000;

    int gov = (strcmp(type, "government") == 0);
    long long sof = 0;
    if (sub < 2500 && !gov) sof = 500;

    long long exm = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < ni; i++) {
        int ex = 0;
        if (strcmp(items[i].category, "food") == 0 && food_ex(state)) ex = 1;
        if (strcmp(items[i].category, "clothing") == 0 && cloth_ex(state)) ex = 1;
        if (strcmp(items[i].category, "medicine") == 0 && med_ex(state)) ex = 1;
        if (ex) exm += items[i].ext_cents - items[i].qty_disc_cents;
    }

    long long txbl = 0, tax = 0;
    if (gov || texempt) {
        txbl = 0; tax = 0;
    } else {
        txbl = ds - exm;
        if (ship_taxed(state)) txbl += shp;
        tax = rhaz(txbl, tax_rate_bp(state), 10000);
    }

    long long pp = ds + tax + shp + fuel + hdl + sof;
    long long ps = rhaz(pp, pay_bp(pay), 10000);

    long long tot = pp + ps;

    char buf[64];
    fmt(sub, buf); printf("SUBTOTAL=%s\n", buf);
    fmt(tqd, buf); printf("QTY_DISCOUNT=%s\n", buf);
    fmt(bd, buf); printf("BULK_DISCOUNT=%s\n", buf);
    fmt(cd, buf); printf("COUPON_DISCOUNT=%s\n", buf);
    fmt(txbl, buf); printf("TAXABLE=%s\n", buf);
    fmt(tax, buf); printf("TAX=%s\n", buf);
    fmt(shp, buf); printf("SHIPPING=%s\n", buf);
    fmt(fuel, buf); printf("FUEL=%s\n", buf);
    fmt(hdl, buf); printf("HANDLING=%s\n", buf);
    fmt(sof, buf); printf("SMALL_ORDER_FEE=%s\n", buf);
    fmt(ps, buf); printf("PAYMENT_SURCHARGE=%s\n", buf);
    fmt(tot, buf); printf("TOTAL=%s\n", buf);

    return 0;
}
<<<END>>>
<<<FILE tests/gen_cases.py>>>
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate test cases for the feecalc reverse-engineering task.

Produces ~500 deterministic inputs covering all input kinds,
boundary values, and edge cases. Uses fixed seed for reproducibility.
"""
import random


def gen_cases(seed=42):
    """Generate test cases. Returns list of (input_string, description) tuples."""
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    cases = []

    STATES = ["CA", "TX", "NY", "FL", "WA", "OR", "MA", "IL", "PA", "OH"]
    TYPES = ["retail", "wholesale", "government"]
    PAYMENTS = ["credit_card", "debit", "ach", "cash", "gift_card"]
    SHIP_METHODS = ["standard", "express", "overnight"]
    ZONES = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
    CATEGORIES = ["general", "food", "clothing", "medicine"]
    COUPONS = ["SAVE10", "SAVE20", "DOLLAR5", "DOLLAR25", "FREESHIP"]

    def add(inp, desc):
        cases.append((inp, desc))

    def mkorder(state="CA", ctype="retail", payment="cash",
                ship_method="standard", ship_zone=1,
                items=None, coupon="", tax_exempt=False):
        if items is None:
            items = [("general", 1, 10.00)]
        lines = [
            "STATE=" + state,
            "TYPE=" + ctype,
            "PAYMENT=" + payment,
            "SHIP_METHOD=" + ship_method,
            "SHIP_ZONE=" + str(ship_zone),
        ]
        if tax_exempt:
            lines.append("TAX_EXEMPT=true")
        if coupon:
            lines.append("COUPON=" + coupon)
        for cat, qty, price in items:
            lines.append("ITEM " + cat + " " + str(qty) + " " + format(price, ".2f"))
        return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"

    # ---- Rounding ties (round-half-away-from-zero) ----
    add(mkorder(state="CA", items=[("general", 1, 2.00)]),
        "rounding: CA $2.00 (tie)")
    add(mkorder(state="WA", items=[("general", 1, 1.00)]),
        "rounding: WA $1.00 (tie)")
    add(mkorder(state="TX", items=[("general", 1, 0.08)]),
        "rounding: TX $0.08 (tie)")
    add(mkorder(state="CA", items=[("general", 1, 10.00)]),
        "rounding: CA $10.00 (tie)")
    add(mkorder(state="OH", items=[("general", 1, 6.00)]),
        "rounding: OH $6.00 (tie)")

    # ---- TAXABLE=0 for government/tax_exempt ----
    add(mkorder(ctype="government", state="CA", items=[("general", 1, 100.00)]),
        "gov: TAXABLE=0 TAX=0")
    add(mkorder(ctype="retail", tax_exempt=True, state="CA", items=[("general", 1, 100.00)]),
        "tax_exempt: TAXABLE=0 TAX=0")
    add(mkorder(ctype="government", tax_exempt=True, state="TX", items=[("general", 1, 200.00)]),
        "gov+tax_exempt: TAXABLE=0")

    # ---- Shipping taxed in TX/FL/OH ----
    for s in ["TX", "FL", "OH"]:
        add(mkorder(state=s, items=[("general", 1, 100.00)]),
            "ship_taxed: " + s)
    for s in ["CA", "NY", "WA", "OR", "MA", "IL", "PA"]:
        add(mkorder(state=s, items=[("general", 1, 100.00)]),
            "ship_not_taxed: " + s)

    # ---- Category exemptions by state ----
    for s in STATES:
        add(mkorder(state=s, items=[("food", 1, 10.00)]),
            "food_in_" + s)
    for s in STATES:
        add(mkorder(state=s, items=[("clothing", 1, 10.00)]),
            "clothing_in_" + s)
    for s in STATES:
        add(mkorder(state=s, items=[("medicine", 1, 10.00)]),
            "medicine_in_" + s)

    # ---- Quantity discount boundaries ----
    add(mkorder(items=[("general", 9, 10.00)]),
        "qty_disc: 9 items no disc")
    add(mkorder(items=[("general", 10, 10.00)]),
        "qty_disc: 10 items 5pct")
    add(mkorder(items=[("general", 49, 10.00)]),
        "qty_disc: 49 items 5pct")
    add(mkorder(items=[("general", 50, 10.00)]),
        "qty_disc: 50 items 10pct")
    add(mkorder(items=[("general", 100, 10.00)]),
        "qty_disc: 100 items 10pct")

    # ---- Bulk discount on post-qty-discount subtotal ----
    add(mkorder(items=[("general", 1, 500.00)]),
        "bulk_retail: 500 -> 3pct")
    add(mkorder(items=[("general", 1, 499.99)]),
        "bulk_retail: 499.99 no bulk")
    add(mkorder(items=[("general", 1, 1000.00)]),
        "bulk_retail: 1000 -> 5pct")
    add(mkorder(items=[("general", 1, 999.99)]),
        "bulk_retail: 999.99 -> 3pct")
    add(mkorder(items=[("general", 50, 10.00)]),
        "bulk_post_qty: 50x10 post-qty=450 no bulk")
    add(mkorder(items=[("general", 60, 10.00)]),
        "bulk_post_qty: 60x10 post-qty=540 3pct bulk")
    add(mkorder(items=[("general", 100, 10.00)]),
        "bulk_post_qty: 100x10 post-qty=900 3pct bulk")

    # ---- Wholesale halved bulk thresholds ----
    add(mkorder(ctype="wholesale", items=[("general", 1, 249.99)]),
        "bulk_wholesale: 249.99 no bulk")
    add(mkorder(ctype="wholesale", items=[("general", 1, 250.00)]),
        "bulk_wholesale: 250 3pct")
    add(mkorder(ctype="wholesale", items=[("general", 1, 499.99)]),
        "bulk_wholesale: 499.99 3pct")
    add(mkorder(ctype="wholesale", items=[("general", 1, 500.00)]),
        "bulk_wholesale: 500 5pct")

    # ---- Coupon minimum on post-discount subtotal ----
    add(mkorder(coupon="SAVE20", items=[("general", 10, 10.00)]),
        "coupon_min: SAVE20 post-disc=95 < 100")
    add(mkorder(coupon="SAVE20", items=[("general", 10, 20.00)]),
        "coupon_min: SAVE20 post-disc high enough")
    add(mkorder(coupon="DOLLAR5", items=[("general", 1, 49.99)]),
        "coupon_min: DOLLAR5 49.99 < 50")
    add(mkorder(coupon="DOLLAR5", items=[("general", 1, 50.00)]),
        "coupon_min: DOLLAR5 50 >= 50")
    add(mkorder(coupon="DOLLAR25", items=[("general", 1, 199.99)]),
        "coupon_min: DOLLAR25 199.99 < 200")
    add(mkorder(coupon="DOLLAR25", items=[("general", 1, 200.00)]),
        "coupon_min: DOLLAR25 200 >= 200")

    # ---- FREESHIP zeroes shipping AND fuel ----
    add(mkorder(ship_method="overnight", ship_zone=5, coupon="FREESHIP",
                items=[("general", 1, 10.00)]),
        "freeship: overnight zone5 SHIPPING=0 FUEL=0")
    add(mkorder(ship_method="express", ship_zone=5, coupon="FREESHIP",
                items=[("general", 1, 10.00)]),
        "freeship: express zone5 SHIPPING=0 FUEL=0")

    # ---- Strict caps for fuel and handling ----
    add(mkorder(ship_method="overnight", ship_zone=5, items=[("general", 1, 10.00)]),
        "fuel_cap: 60 ship fuel=6 > 5 capped")
    add(mkorder(ship_method="overnight", ship_zone=4, items=[("general", 1, 10.00)]),
        "fuel_cap: 48 ship fuel=4.80 not capped")
    add(mkorder(items=[("general", 16, 1.00)]),
        "handling_cap: 16 items 10.00 exactly not capped")
    add(mkorder(items=[("general", 17, 1.00)]),
        "handling_cap: 17 items 10.50 > 10 capped")
    add(mkorder(items=[("general", 15, 1.00)]),
        "handling: 15 items 9.50 not capped")

    # ---- Small order fee ----
    add(mkorder(items=[("general", 1, 24.99)]),
        "small_order: 24.99 < 25 fee 5")
    add(mkorder(items=[("general", 1, 25.00)]),
        "small_order: 25.00 = 25 no fee")
    add(mkorder(ctype="government", items=[("general", 1, 20.00)]),
        "small_order_gov: 20 < 25 gov waived")
    add(mkorder(ctype="government", items=[("general", 1, 10.00)]),
        "small_order_gov: 10 < 25 gov waived")
    add(mkorder(coupon="SAVE10", items=[("general", 1, 20.00)]),
        "small_order_coupon: 20 pre-disc < 25 fee 5")

    # ---- ACH negative surcharge ----
    add(mkorder(payment="ach", items=[("general", 1, 100.00)]),
        "ach: negative surcharge")
    add(mkorder(payment="ach", state="TX", items=[("general", 1, 100.00)]),
        "ach_tx: negative surcharge with ship tax")

    # ---- Invalid coupon = no discount, not error ----
    add(mkorder(coupon="BOGUS", items=[("general", 1, 100.00)]),
        "invalid_coupon: BOGUS no disc exit 0")
    add(mkorder(coupon="INVALID", items=[("general", 1, 50.00)]),
        "invalid_coupon: INVALID no disc exit 0")

    # ---- Error priority ----
    add("TYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=bitcoin\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general -1 10.00\n",
        "error_priority: missing STATE first")
    add("STATE=CA\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
        "error: missing TYPE")
    add("PAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
        "error_priority: missing STATE+TYPE -> missing STATE")

    # ---- All payment methods ----
    for p in PAYMENTS:
        add(mkorder(payment=p, items=[("general", 1, 100.00)]),
            "payment_" + p)

    # ---- All shipping methods x zones ----
    for sm in SHIP_METHODS:
        for z in ZONES:
            add(mkorder(ship_method=sm, ship_zone=z, items=[("general", 1, 50.00)]),
                "ship_" + sm + "_zone" + str(z))

    # ---- All coupons with adequate subtotal ----
    for c in COUPONS:
        add(mkorder(coupon=c, items=[("general", 1, 200.00)]),
            "coupon_" + c + "_adequate")

    # ---- Government + various states ----
    for s in ["CA", "TX", "NY", "FL", "WA"]:
        add(mkorder(ctype="government", state=s, items=[("general", 1, 100.00)]),
            "government_" + s)

    # ---- Wholesale + various ----
    add(mkorder(ctype="wholesale", items=[("general", 1, 300.00)]),
        "wholesale_300")
    add(mkorder(ctype="wholesale", coupon="SAVE10", items=[("general", 1, 300.00)]),
        "wholesale_save10_300")

    # ---- Multi-item orders ----
    add(mkorder(items=[("general", 5, 20.00), ("food", 3, 10.00)]),
        "multi: general+food in CA")
    add(mkorder(state="TX", items=[("general", 5, 20.00), ("food", 3, 10.00)]),
        "multi: general+food in TX (food taxed)")
    add(mkorder(state="PA", items=[("general", 5, 20.00), ("clothing", 3, 10.00)]),
        "multi: general+clothing in PA (clothing exempt)")
    add(mkorder(items=[("general", 10, 50.00), ("clothing", 5, 30.00), ("medicine", 2, 20.00)]),
        "multi: 3 categories")

    # ---- Tax exempt with various states ----
    for s in ["CA", "TX", "WA", "OR", "MA"]:
        add(mkorder(state=s, tax_exempt=True, items=[("general", 1, 100.00)]),
            "tax_exempt_" + s)

    # ---- Error cases ----
    add("TYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
        "error: missing STATE")
    add("STATE=CA\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
        "error: missing TYPE")
    add("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
        "error: missing PAYMENT")
    add("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
        "error: missing SHIP_METHOD")
    add("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
        "error: missing SHIP_ZONE")
    add("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\n",
        "error: no items")
    add("STATE=ZZ\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
        "error: unknown state")
    add("STATE=CA\nTYPE=business\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
        "error: unknown type")
    add("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=bitcoin\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
        "error: unknown payment")
    add("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=teleport\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
        "error: unknown shipping")
    add("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=0\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
        "error: invalid zone 0")
    add("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=6\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
        "error: invalid zone 6")
    add("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=9\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
        "error: invalid zone 9")
    add("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general -1 10.00\n",
        "error: negative quantity")
    add("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 -10.00\n",
        "error: negative price")

    # ---- More error priority ----
    add("STATE=ZZ\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\n",
        "error_priority: unknown state + no items -> no items")
    add("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general -1 -10.00\n",
        "error_priority: neg qty + neg price -> neg qty")
    add("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=bitcoin\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=9\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
        "error_priority: unknown payment + invalid zone -> unknown payment")

    # ---- All states basic ----
    for s in STATES:
        add(mkorder(state=s, items=[("general", 1, 100.00)]),
            "basic_" + s)

    # ---- Fill up to 500 with random combinations ----
    while len(cases) < 500:
        s = rng.choice(STATES)
        t = rng.choice(TYPES)
        p = rng.choice(PAYMENTS)
        sm = rng.choice(SHIP_METHODS)
        z = rng.choice(ZONES)
        c = rng.choice(COUPONS + ["", "BOGUS", "XYZ"])
        te = rng.choice([True, False, False, False])
        n_items = rng.randint(1, 4)
        item_list = []
        for _ in range(n_items):
            cat = rng.choice(CATEGORIES)
            qty = rng.choice([1, 2, 5, 9, 10, 15, 25, 49, 50, 60, 100])
            price = rng.choice([1.00, 5.00, 10.00, 15.00, 20.00, 25.00, 50.00,
                                75.00, 99.99, 100.00, 200.00, 250.00, 499.99, 500.00,
                                999.99, 1000.00])
            item_list.append((cat, qty, price))
        add(mkorder(state=s, ctype=t, payment=p, ship_method=sm, ship_zone=z,
                    items=item_list, coupon=c, tax_exempt=te),
            "random_" + str(len(cases)))

    return cases[:500]

<<<FILE tests/test_outputs.py>>>
"""Test suite for the feecalc reverse-engineering task.

Compiles the reference C source, hides the installed binary,
then compares reference vs artifact output on sample and generated inputs.
"""
import subprocess
import os
import sys
import pytest

REFERENCE_SRC = "/tests/reference.c"
ARTIFACT = "/app/quotelib.py"
IMAGE_PYTHON = "/usr/bin/python3"
SAMPLE_FILE = "/app/sample.txt"
FEECALC_BIN = "/usr/local/bin/feecalc"
FEECALC_HIDDEN = "/usr/local/bin/feecalc.hidden"


def _run_cmd(args, input_text, env=None):
    """Run a command with input, return (stdout, stderr, returncode)."""
    kw = dict(input=input_text, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
    if env is not None:
        kw["env"] = env
    r = subprocess.run(args, **kw)
    return r.stdout, r.stderr, r.returncode


def run_reference(bin_path, input_text):
    """Run the compiled reference binary."""
    return _run_cmd([bin_path], input_text)


def run_artifact(input_text):
    """Run the Python artifact with the image's Python interpreter."""
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env["PATH"] = "/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin"
    env.pop("VIRTUAL_ENV", None)
    return _run_cmd([IMAGE_PYTHON, ARTIFACT], input_text, env=env)


def assert_match(ref_bin, input_text, context=""):
    """Compare reference and artifact output; fail with diagnostic on mismatch."""
    r_out, r_err, r_rc = run_reference(ref_bin, input_text)
    a_out, a_err, a_rc = run_artifact(input_text)
    parts = []
    if r_out != a_out:
        parts.append("STDOUT differs:\n  ref: " + repr(r_out) + "\n  art: " + repr(a_out))
    if r_err != a_err:
        parts.append("STDERR differs:\n  ref: " + repr(r_err) + "\n  art: " + repr(a_err))
    if r_rc != a_rc:
        parts.append("EXIT CODE differs: ref=" + str(r_rc) + " art=" + str(a_rc))
    if parts:
        msg = context + "\nInput:\n" + input_text + "\n" + "\n".join(parts)
        pytest.fail(msg)


@pytest.fixture(scope="session")
def ref_bin(tmp_path_factory):
    """Compile reference.c and return path to compiled binary."""
    out = str(tmp_path_factory.mktemp("ref") / "feecalc_ref")
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["gcc", "-O2", "-std=c11", "-o", out, REFERENCE_SRC],
        capture_output=True, text=True,
    )
    assert result.returncode == 0, "Reference compilation failed: " + result.stderr
    assert os.path.exists(out), "Compiled binary not found at " + out
    return out


@pytest.fixture(scope="session", autouse=True)
def hide_feecalc():
    """Hide the original feecalc binary so the artifact cannot call it."""
    hidden = False
    if os.path.exists(FEECALC_BIN):
        os.rename(FEECALC_BIN, FEECALC_HIDDEN)
        hidden = True
    assert not os.path.exists(FEECALC_BIN), "feecalc still visible at " + FEECALC_BIN
    yield
    if hidden and os.path.exists(FEECALC_HIDDEN):
        os.rename(FEECALC_HIDDEN, FEECALC_BIN)


def test_artifact_exists():
    """The artifact file must exist."""
    assert os.path.isfile(ARTIFACT), "Artifact not found at " + ARTIFACT


def test_module_importable():
    """The artifact must be importable and expose calculate()."""
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env["PATH"] = "/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin"
    env.pop("VIRTUAL_ENV", None)
    r = subprocess.run(
        [IMAGE_PYTHON, "-c",
         "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/app'); import quotelib; "
         "assert hasattr(quotelib, 'calculate'), 'no calculate'"],
        capture_output=True, text=True, env=env,
    )
    assert r.returncode == 0, "Import failed: " + r.stderr + "\n" + r.stdout


def test_compiled_reference(ref_bin):
    """The reference binary was compiled successfully (checked by fixture)."""
    assert os.path.exists(ref_bin)


def test_binary_hidden():
    """The original feecalc binary must be hidden."""
    assert not os.path.exists(FEECALC_BIN), "feecalc should be hidden"


def test_sample_inputs(ref_bin):
    """Run all sample orders through both programs and compare."""
    assert os.path.isfile(SAMPLE_FILE), "Sample file not found at " + SAMPLE_FILE
    data = open(SAMPLE_FILE).read()
    blocks = data.split("===")
    count = 0
    for block in blocks:
        block = block.strip()
        if not block:
            continue
        count += 1
        assert_match(ref_bin, block + "\n",
                     context="Sample block #" + str(count))


def test_generated_cases(ref_bin):
    """Run all generated inputs through both programs and compare."""
    sys.path.insert(0, "/tests")
    from gen_cases import gen_cases
    cases = gen_cases()
    for i, (inp, desc) in enumerate(cases):
        assert_match(ref_bin, inp,
                     context="Generated case #" + str(i) + ": " + desc)


def test_rounding_half_up(ref_bin):
    """Specific tie-breaking inputs that require round-half-up."""
    ties = [
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 2.00\n",
         "CA $2.00 -> TAX=0.15"),
        ("STATE=WA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 1.00\n",
         "WA $1.00 -> TAX=0.07"),
        ("STATE=TX\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 0.08\n",
         "TX $0.08 -> TAX=0.01"),
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
         "CA $10.00 -> TAX=0.73"),
        ("STATE=OH\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 6.00\n",
         "OH $6.00 -> TAX=0.35"),
    ]
    for inp, desc in ties:
        assert_match(ref_bin, inp, context="Rounding tie: " + desc)


def test_tax_exempt_taxable_zero(ref_bin):
    """Government and tax_exempt must show TAXABLE=0.00 and TAX=0.00."""
    cases_list = [
        "STATE=CA\nTYPE=government\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 100.00\n",
        "STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nTAX_EXEMPT=true\nITEM general 1 100.00\n",
        "STATE=TX\nTYPE=government\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 5 50.00\n",
    ]
    for i, inp in enumerate(cases_list):
        assert_match(ref_bin, inp, context="Tax exempt TAXABLE=0 case #" + str(i))


def test_shipping_taxed(ref_bin):
    """TX/FL/OH include shipping in TAXABLE; others do not."""
    for s in ["TX", "FL", "OH"]:
        inp = ("STATE=" + s + "\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\n"
               "SHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 100.00\n")
        assert_match(ref_bin, inp, context="Shipping taxed in " + s)
    for s in ["CA", "NY", "WA"]:
        inp = ("STATE=" + s + "\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\n"
               "SHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 100.00\n")
        assert_match(ref_bin, inp, context="Shipping not taxed in " + s)


def test_category_exemptions_all_states(ref_bin):
    """Food, clothing, medicine exemptions tested in all 10 states."""
    states = ["CA", "TX", "NY", "FL", "WA", "OR", "MA", "IL", "PA", "OH"]
    for s in states:
        inp = ("STATE=" + s + "\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\n"
               "SHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM food 1 10.00\n")
        assert_match(ref_bin, inp, context="Food in " + s)
    for s in states:
        inp = ("STATE=" + s + "\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\n"
               "SHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM clothing 1 10.00\n")
        assert_match(ref_bin, inp, context="Clothing in " + s)
    for s in states:
        inp = ("STATE=" + s + "\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\n"
               "SHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM medicine 1 10.00\n")
        assert_match(ref_bin, inp, context="Medicine in " + s)


def test_medicine_in_wa(ref_bin):
    """WA state: medicine is NOT exempt (taxed). Other states: exempt."""
    wa_inp = ("STATE=WA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\n"
              "SHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM medicine 1 10.00\n")
    assert_match(ref_bin, wa_inp, context="Medicine in WA (taxed)")
    ca_inp = ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\n"
              "SHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM medicine 1 10.00\n")
    assert_match(ref_bin, ca_inp, context="Medicine in CA (exempt)")


def test_quantity_discount_boundaries(ref_bin):
    """Quantity boundaries: 9 (none), 10 (5%), 49 (5%), 50 (10%), 100 (10%)."""
    for qty, desc in [(9, "no disc"), (10, "5pct"), (49, "5pct"), (50, "10pct"), (100, "10pct")]:
        inp = ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\n"
               "SHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general " + str(qty) + " 10.00\n")
        assert_match(ref_bin, inp, context="Qty " + str(qty) + " " + desc)


def test_bulk_discount_boundaries(ref_bin):
    """Retail bulk boundaries on post-qty-discount subtotal."""
    cases_list = [
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 499.99\n",
         "$499.99 no bulk"),
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 500.00\n",
         "$500.00 3pct bulk"),
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 999.99\n",
         "$999.99 3pct bulk"),
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 1000.00\n",
         "$1000.00 5pct bulk"),
    ]
    for inp, desc in cases_list:
        assert_match(ref_bin, inp, context="Bulk boundary: " + desc)


def test_wholesale_bulk_thresholds(ref_bin):
    """Wholesale has halved bulk thresholds: $250 (3%), $500 (5%)."""
    cases_list = [
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=wholesale\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 249.99\n",
         "$249.99 no bulk"),
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=wholesale\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 250.00\n",
         "$250.00 3pct bulk"),
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=wholesale\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 499.99\n",
         "$499.99 3pct bulk"),
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=wholesale\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 500.00\n",
         "$500.00 5pct bulk"),
    ]
    for inp, desc in cases_list:
        assert_match(ref_bin, inp, context="Wholesale bulk: " + desc)


def test_coupon_logic(ref_bin):
    """Coupon codes and their minimums."""
    cases_list = [
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nCOUPON=SAVE10\nITEM general 1 100.00\n",
         "SAVE10 always applies"),
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nCOUPON=SAVE20\nITEM general 1 99.99\n",
         "SAVE20 below $100 min"),
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nCOUPON=SAVE20\nITEM general 1 100.00\n",
         "SAVE20 at $100 min"),
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nCOUPON=DOLLAR5\nITEM general 1 49.99\n",
         "DOLLAR5 below $50 min"),
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nCOUPON=DOLLAR5\nITEM general 1 50.00\n",
         "DOLLAR5 at $50 min"),
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nCOUPON=DOLLAR25\nITEM general 1 199.99\n",
         "DOLLAR25 below $200 min"),
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nCOUPON=DOLLAR25\nITEM general 1 200.00\n",
         "DOLLAR25 at $200 min"),
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nCOUPON=BOGUS\nITEM general 1 100.00\n",
         "Invalid coupon no disc exit 0"),
    ]
    for inp, desc in cases_list:
        assert_match(ref_bin, inp, context="Coupon: " + desc)


def test_freeship_fuel(ref_bin):
    """FREESHIP zeroes both SHIPPING and FUEL."""
    inp = ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=overnight\n"
           "SHIP_ZONE=5\nCOUPON=FREESHIP\nITEM general 1 10.00\n")
    assert_match(ref_bin, inp, context="FREESHIP overnight zone5")


def test_fee_caps(ref_bin):
    """Fuel cap at >$5.00; handling cap at >$10.00 (strict greater)."""
    inp1 = ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=overnight\n"
            "SHIP_ZONE=5\nITEM general 1 10.00\n")
    assert_match(ref_bin, inp1, context="Fuel cap: $60 ship")
    inp2 = ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\n"
            "SHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 16 1.00\n")
    assert_match(ref_bin, inp2, context="Handling cap: 16 items = $10.00 exactly")
    inp3 = ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\n"
            "SHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 17 1.00\n")
    assert_match(ref_bin, inp3, context="Handling cap: 17 items = $10.50 capped")


def test_small_order_fee(ref_bin):
    """Small order fee $5.00 when pre-discount subtotal < $25.00; waived for government."""
    cases_list = [
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 24.99\n",
         "$24.99 < $25 fee $5"),
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 25.00\n",
         "$25.00 = $25 no fee"),
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=government\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 20.00\n",
         "Gov $20 < $25 waived"),
    ]
    for inp, desc in cases_list:
        assert_match(ref_bin, inp, context="Small order: " + desc)


def test_payment_methods(ref_bin):
    """All payment methods including ACH (negative surcharge)."""
    for p in ["credit_card", "debit", "ach", "cash", "gift_card"]:
        inp = ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=" + p + "\n"
               "SHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 100.00\n")
        assert_match(ref_bin, inp, context="Payment: " + p)


def test_error_priority(ref_bin):
    """First error in priority order is reported."""
    inp1 = ("TYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=bitcoin\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\n"
            "SHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general -1 10.00\n")
    assert_match(ref_bin, inp1, context="Error priority: missing STATE first")
    inp2 = ("STATE=ZZ\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\n"
            "SHIP_ZONE=1\n")
    assert_match(ref_bin, inp2, context="Error priority: no items before unknown state")
    inp3 = ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\n"
            "SHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general -1 -10.00\n")
    assert_match(ref_bin, inp3, context="Error priority: neg qty before neg price")


def test_error_cases(ref_bin):
    """Specific validation errors with exact messages and exit codes."""
    errors = [
        ("TYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
         "missing STATE"),
        ("STATE=CA\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
         "missing TYPE"),
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
         "missing PAYMENT"),
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
         "missing SHIP_METHOD"),
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
         "missing SHIP_ZONE"),
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\n",
         "no items"),
        ("STATE=ZZ\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
         "unknown state"),
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=business\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
         "unknown type"),
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=bitcoin\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
         "unknown payment"),
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=teleport\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
         "unknown shipping"),
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=0\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
         "invalid zone 0"),
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=9\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
         "invalid zone 9"),
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general -1 10.00\n",
         "negative quantity"),
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 -10.00\n",
         "negative price"),
    ]
    for inp, desc in errors:
        assert_match(ref_bin, inp, context="Error: " + desc)
